files_or_snippet: No code reused. Browser (GitHub) searches run: 'javascript expression parser calculator shunting-yard' and 'recursive descent calculator javascript implicit multiplication MIT' (0 repository results).
how_adapted: NOTE: No usable existing implementation was found, so src/calc.js and src/repl.js were written from scratch. Inspected but NOT copied: https://github.com/Motardo/calc (GPL-3.0; minimal shunting-yard supporting only + - * / ^ with no functions, variables, unary operators, implicit multiplication or error positions). Its license and coverage made it unsuitable to vendor.
